assumptions: The flag reached through the pointer held at 0x64ed290 is read only as a zero/nonzero byte; what that flag means at source level is not pinned.
The copied record's second qword is read only as a null/non-null pointer whose +0x08 dword is incremented; the target's kind is not pinned.
The selector's +0x68 byte is read only as a zero/nonzero switch; the selector object's kind is not pinned.

copy.selector_null: a null selector selects the default record
copy.selector_switch: byte at selector + 0x68: zero selects the default record, nonzero selects the alternate record

exits.condition: copied second qword is non-null and the flag byte is nonzero
exits.form: plain add of 1 to the dword at target + 0x08, then plain return

exits.condition: copied second qword is non-null and the flag byte is zero
exits.form: locked add of 1 to the dword at target + 0x08, then plain return

routine.arguments: destination pointer in rdi, source pointer in rsi
routine.writes: exactly the 16 destination bytes, plus the one incremented dword when the copied second qword is non-null
